world.title: 'Could endanger his life': Imran Khan's son warns against Adiala jail protest
world.summary: Imran Khan's son, Kasim Khan, has cautioned Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) supporters against protesting at Adiala jail in Rawalpindi. He expressed concerns that such a march could jeopardize his father's safety. The warning comes ahead of a planned protest on September 27, emphasizing the potential risks involved for both supporters and Imran Khan himself during the demonstration.

world.title: Humanitarian crisis worsens in Ceuta as thousands remain stranded
world.summary: In Ceuta, Spain, a humanitarian crisis intensifies as thousands remain stranded under harsh conditions, facing overcrowding, limited aid, and reported abuse. Many, like 21-year-old Anis Fadi, have been living in makeshift shelters since crossing from Morocco at the end of July. They await decisions regarding their future, highlighting the urgent need for humanitarian assistance in the region.

world.title: Russia sanctions law while India faces tariff risk?
world.summary: The United States has extended its trade truce with China, but a new Russia sanctions law introduces potential tariffs of up to 10%. This development raises uncertainty regarding how China and India may be treated differently by Washington. The implications of these tariffs could affect trade dynamics and economic relations between the U.S., China, and India moving forward.

business.title: Comfortable 7-Seater To Buy Under A Budget
business.summary: The rising demand for family vehicles has led automakers to develop new three-row SUVs and MPVs. However, the larger size and features of these SUVs often result in higher prices, making it challenging for budget-conscious buyers. Many Indian consumers are seeking affordable 7-seater options that offer ample space, efficiency, and lower ownership costs to accommodate their families.

business.title: Hero Sales Breakup Aug 2026 - Splendor, Deluxe, Destini, Vida, Passion, Xtreme, Glamour
business.summary: Hero MotoCorp reported domestic sales of 541,038 units in August 2026, marking a 4.53% increase compared to the previous year. The Splendor and HF Deluxe models were the top performers, together accounting for 78.3% of total sales. Other models, including Destini, Vida, Passion, Xtreme, and Glamour, contributed to the overall sales figures but in lesser volumes.

business.title: Centre to borrow Rs 7.86 lakh crore in H2FY27; full-year borrowing below Budget estimate
business.summary: The central government plans to borrow Rs 7.86 lakh crore in the second half of financial year 2026-27, utilizing dated securities and including Rs 15,000 crore through Sovereign Green Bonds. The total market borrowing for the full year is projected at nearly Rs 16 lakh crore, which is Rs 1.20 lakh crore lower than the FY27 Budget estimate.

technology.title: From PGA Tour 2K25 To The Division 2: XBOX Offers Four Games In Free Play Days Event This Weekend
technology.summary: XBOX is hosting a Free Play Days event this weekend, allowing Game Pass users to play four popular games for free from September 24 to September 27, 2026. The featured titles include PGA Tour 2K25, The Division 2, The Escapists 2, and Young Suns. This initiative aims to enhance user engagement and provide access to diverse gaming experiences.

technology.title: The Next Halo Game From Halo Studios Was Reportedly Still Years Away, Before Microsoft Handed the Franchise to Activision
technology.summary: Microsoft has reportedly canceled the next Halo game from Halo Studios, which was still years away from launch. The decision comes alongside the transfer of other game developers, including Rare and World's Edge, to Activision. This shift raises questions about the future of the Halo franchise and the potential direction of upcoming titles within the new structure.

technology.title: Halo 2 and 3 Remakes Reportedly Shelved as Xbox's Halo Shake-Up Continues
technology.summary: A report indicates that Halo Studios has shelved the remakes of Halo 2 and 3 amid ongoing changes at Xbox following the franchise's transition to Activision. This decision is part of a broader restructuring effort described as the “Xbox Reset,” which was announced by CEO Phil Spencer. The future of other projects remains uncertain as developments unfold.

sports.title: Asian Games: Gulveer Singh races into 10,000m silver as India's athletics surge continues in Nagoya
sports.summary: Indian long-distance runner Gulveer Singh secured a silver medal in the men's 10,000m final at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya. This achievement marks an improvement from his previous bronze medal performance. Singh's success contributes to India's growing prominence in athletics at the Games, showcasing the nation's talent in long-distance running on an international stage.

sports.title: adidas Celebrate Lionel Messi’s Legendary Argentina Career With Special Edition Farewell Jersey
sports.summary: adidas has launched a special edition farewell jersey to honor Lionel Messi's illustrious career with the Argentina national team. The jersey features premium gold details and incorporates iconic national symbols, celebrating Messi's contributions to football. This initiative reflects the brand's recognition of Messi's impact on the sport and his legacy as one of football's greatest players.

sports.title: Know where to watch live streaming and telecast
sports.summary: The Indian men's kabaddi team will compete against Iran in the final for the gold medal at the Asian Games 2026. The match is set to take place at the Tokai Citizens Gymnasium in Aichi, Japan, on Saturday. Viewers can find information on live streaming and telecast options in India for the India vs Iran match.

health.title: DNA in blood signals cancer risk years ahead
health.summary: Researchers analyzed blood samples taken up to nine years prior to cancer diagnoses, identifying early DNA changes linked to cancer development. The study, published in Cell Genomics, highlights the body's biological response to initial cancer signs. These findings may enhance early detection methods, potentially allowing for interventions before the disease progresses significantly, thereby improving patient outcomes.

health.title: Cocoon Hospital highlights role of HPV vaccine in cervical cancer prevention
health.summary: Cocoon Hospital in Chandigarh hosted a media interaction at the Press Club to promote awareness of the HPV vaccine's role in preventing cervical cancer. The event featured discussions among media professionals on HPV infection, preventive healthcare, and the significance of timely awareness for women and families. The initiative aims to enhance understanding of vaccination benefits in cancer prevention.

health.title: “It’s just a thyroid problem”: Doctor explains why women should never ignore these changes in the neck
health.summary: Doctors advise women not to ignore changes in the neck, such as swelling, voice alterations, or lumps. These symptoms are often attributed to stress or hormonal changes, but they may indicate thyroid issues. Early detection and evaluation are crucial for addressing potential thyroid problems, emphasizing the importance of seeking medical attention rather than dismissing these signs.

science.title: Scientists Discover First Microblazar Black Hole In The Milky Way
science.summary: Astronomers have identified the Milky Way's first microblazar, a black hole named IRAS 18293-0941. This black hole is actively consuming matter and emitting a powerful jet of plasma directed towards Earth at nearly the speed of light. The discovery marks a significant milestone in understanding black holes and their behavior within our galaxy.

science.title: Japan's first named ankylosaur, Nipponopelta yezoensis, was more closely related to North American and European nodosaurids millions of years ago
science.summary: Researchers have formally named a new ankylosaur genus and species, Nipponopelta yezoensis, discovered over thirty years ago in Hokkaido. This marks Japan's first named ankylosaur. The study indicates that Nipponopelta is more closely related to North American and European nodosaurids than previously thought, providing insights into the evolutionary relationships of these armored dinosaurs from millions of years ago.

entertainment.title: Anthony Russo Talks About
entertainment.summary: Anthony Russo announced that the re-released version of Avengers: Endgame, titled Avengers Endgame: Encore, includes new footage that enhances the Avengers' storyline. This special re-release aims to prepare audiences for the upcoming film, Avengers: Doomsday. The additional content is designed to provide deeper context and connections within the Marvel Cinematic Universe, enriching the overall viewing experience.

entertainment.title: Raghubir Yadav says playing godman Baapji accused of sexual abuse in Aneet Padda starrer ‘Hunkkaar’ felt like ‘fighting death every day because of pain’: ‘My heartbeat would rise’
entertainment.summary: Veteran actor Raghubir Yadav discussed the challenges of portraying Baapji, a godman accused of sexual abuse, in the series "Hunkkaar: The Roar." He described the role as emotionally and physically taxing, likening the experience to "fighting death every day" due to the intense pain it caused him. Yadav noted that his heartbeat would rise while performing.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, September 26, 2026: Patience may help you navigate changing circumstances with greater ease
entertainment.summary: On September 26, 2026, horoscopes suggest that patience will be crucial for navigating changing circumstances. Predictions will be available for all sun signs, providing insights into potential challenges and opportunities. Kishori Sud, a spiritual practitioner and intuitive guide with over five years of experience in tarot reading and holistic healing, offers her expertise in these forecasts.
